stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS (the US government's college data) and College Navigator (fall 2024): 757 applicants, 100% admitted (rounded; the admit count is not printed), 19% of admitted enrolled. The newest Common Data Set UMPI posts is 2021-2022 (umpi.edu/about/common-data-set), so it was not used; SAT/ACT percentiles, GPA, international applicants and admits, and the admission factors are not shown. IPEDS lists SAT/ACT as not considered, while the admissions site says scores are optional and can qualify a student for the Merit Award. Enrollment (2,758 undergraduates) includes UMPI's large online/competency-based YourPace program; admissions figures are not split out by on-campus vs online. The applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the exact IPEDS figures for fall 2023, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
